summary: Learn Tax Administration Modernization Training with TADAT, OECD guidance, and practical dashboards. Build reform plans and compliance controls today.
lede: Tax administration modernization helps operations, compliance, and policy professionals improve registration, filing, service, and collection processes. The training covers diagnostic scorecards and workflow mapping, alongside compliance-risk analysis, arrears segmentation, and KPI dashboard design. Learners also develop data-governance controls and a phased modernization roadmap to turn findings into practical actions and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work inside or alongside tax administration operations and need to improve service delivery, compliance management, and modernization planning.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop and be prepared to work with sample tax administration datasets, process maps, and dashboard templates. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet analysis and common tax administration terminology is helpful; prior programming experience is not required.
